# Requirements Skill

Use this skill to define the project scope and acceptance criteria from the source story.

Procedure:
1. Read input/user-story.md and identify the business goal, user need, constraints, and missing facts.
2. Ask only blocking questions that are required to make the scope testable.
3. Record the approved answers and define the MVP scope, assumptions, and acceptance criteria.
4. Validate that the result is concise, testable, and traceable to the original story.
5. Stop for human approval before treating the requirements as approved.

Do not broaden scope beyond the approved story and clarifications.
